serverGuide.title: **F&T Server Guide** ⚰️
serverGuide.description: Welcome to F&T here is a quick server guide to help you know where you want to go:

fields.name: Welcome 🌙
fields.value: This is where you will find welcoming messages for new members who have just joined the server, learn about the rules that you need to follow and announcements within the discord server.

fields.name: Twitch Area 📺
fields.value: The twitch area is the main catergory within the server, this is where you will find, stream notifications when F&T are live on twitch, you will be able to link your twitch account as well to get perks within discord please make sure you read the embed in ⁠<#1507762669359464649> as not everyone is eliagble for the perks, you will be able to post clips that you have got from F&T's stream, and you will be able to discover more about Todd the F&T's mascot and helper.

fields.name: Cozy & Chill ⚰️
fields.value: This catergory is for venting, late night photography/chats, telling storys and telling people about your dreams/plans for the future.

fields.name: Community Forest 💜
fields.value: This is an area full of fun things ranging from general chat, memes channel (where todd posts everyday at 3am GMT), music channels, arts and crafts, pet pictures etc

fields.name: Voice Channels 🪶
fields.value: This is where you will find a variety of voice channels that lost souls can hop in at any time to game, chat, watch streams etc

serverGuide.footer: You're offically part of the family now! 🔮

ticket.panelDescription: Are you looking for some support? Have an issue within the server or a problem with a member/staff? Press the button below to open a private ticket channel for support. A new ticket will be created for you.
ticket.panelFooter: A support ticket will be created for you, please read information inside the ticket!
ticket.ticketDescription: Thank you for opening a ticket, <@&1507805275309080628>  will be with you as soon as possible. Please not that if its __an emergency__ please ping /@forest keeper they will get to you when they can, if a staff member does respond to your ticket and deems it necessary that it needs esculating they will pass it on to a moderator. Please keep in mind if you are spam pinging any member of staff whether it is a staff member, mod, or admin you will recieve modlogs, we will get to you as quick as possible, please be paitent with us. On another note if the any of the below apply to you please send it in a text message this will help staff support you as quickly and effeciently as they can.

ticketFields.name: A clear description of the issue or question
ticketFields.value: Please make sure you provide staff with a clear description of what has happened.

ticketFields.name: Any relevant screenshots or error messages
ticketFields.value: Please provide staff with any relevant screenshots/screen grabs of your situation.

ticketFields.name: If any, the person of concern username or other important details
ticketFields.value: if possible please provide user id for the individual and a screenshot/screengrab of their profile.
